Definition: Cost or price is named as a basis for keeping or dropping a supplier
Inclusion criteria: Explicit reference to price or cost in a retention decision
Exclusion criteria: General cost talk not tied to a retention decision
Example excerpt: Mostly on price, to be honest

Definition: Personal trust or relationship is named as a basis for retention
Inclusion criteria: Explicit reference to trust or a personal relationship as a reason
Exclusion criteria: Mentions of relationships that are explicitly rejected as a criterion — code as TRUST_REJ
Example excerpt: I also keep the ones I trust

Definition: Speaker states that relationships should not or do not count
Inclusion criteria: Explicit denial that relationships are a criterion
Example excerpt: I do not want it to be about relationships

Definition: Audit or compliance outcome ends or overrides a relationship
Inclusion criteria: Explicit statement that audit or compliance findings decide
Example excerpt: A failed audit ends the relationship regardless of price

Definition: A structured scoring instrument is named as the decision mechanism
Inclusion criteria: Mention of a scorecard or formal scoring

Definition: Was merged into SCORE_01 in v2
